name: github-desktop-plus
description: External enhancement tool for GitHub Desktop — Rust runtime + 0-path Electron hooks

scripts.gdp:build: pnpm run locales:prepare && pnpm run build:hooks && cargo build --workspace
scripts.gdp:dev: pnpm run locales:prepare && pnpm run build:hooks && cargo run -p gdp -- dev
scripts.check: pnpm run locales:prepare && pnpm run build:hooks && cargo check --workspace
scripts.build: pnpm run locales:prepare && pnpm run build:hooks && cargo build --workspace --release
scripts.self-check:desktop: pnpm run locales:prepare && pnpm run build:hooks && tsx scripts/self-check-desktop.ts
